nodes.label: Gnomo Sprite (2D character art)
nodes.description: Full-body 2D character sprite in flat cel-shaded line-art style. Figure stands bottom-aligned on a tall canvas with large empty headroom above.
nodes.rationale: Bottom-anchored figure on an oversized canvas suggests sprites share a common canvas size and ground baseline so characters line up consistently when rendered.

nodes.label: Gnomo (Gnome / elf-like mountain character)
nodes.description: Young pointy-eared character with dark messy hair and ponytail, wearing layered forest-green vest, sash and baggy trousers over a pale shirt, with dark green boots; one hand on hip, the other raised in a beckoning or explaining gesture.

nodes.label: Scroll Bundle (carried rolled papers)
nodes.description: Rolled parchment scrolls carried on the back and at the hip, suggesting a messenger, scribe or keeper-of-knowledge role.

nodes.label: Crossed-Tools Medallion
nodes.description: Round grey medallion hanging from the belt bearing crossed tool icons (hammer/pick-like), hinting at a craftsman or mining guild emblem.
